messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — P1: dedicated-reserved-pool-exhaustion for tenant=AcmeCorp, cluster=dedicated-acme-eu-west, metric=queue_length>500 sustained for 3m :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: PagerDuty notification sent to #eng-oncall, escalation policy: oncall->sre-lead->eng-infra
Sam: ack — taking initial triage (oncall). grabbing context.
Priya: pinging infra to confirm node health, Sam — can you attach the most recent p95/p99 latency from the Console?
Sam: copied slices from console:
```
endpoint: /v1/generate (acme api key)
window: 2026-03-14T01:00Z - 2026-03-14T01:10Z
p50: 210ms, p95: 1.8s, p99: 3.6s
5xx rate: 12% (baseline <0.3%)
queue_length: 620
```
Sam: impact appears widespread for AcmeCorp dedicated cluster. Customers seeing 503s and long tail latency.
Maya: customer-facing update: AcmeCorp support alerted; engineering told them we're investigating. No SLO breach confirmed yet but they have a live critical workflow.
Jordan: looking at cluster autoscaler logs — reserved pool didn't scale because reserved capacity was at commit and autoscaler rejected burst due to policy "no-burst-for-reserved-tenants". I'm checking node failures.
Priya: any recent deploys to that cluster?
deploy-bot: deploy event — service=redwood-runtime, cluster=dedicated-acme-eu-west, image=redwood-runtime:v2026.03.13-9c2a, user=ci-bot, status=success, ts=1796199200
Sam: deploy looks recent-ish. Jordan, can you confirm pod restarts?
Jordan: yes — several runtime pods restarted repeatedly over the last 8m with OOMKilled and 502 from envoy. Kernel logs show GPU driver disconnect on 3 nodes.
Jordan: runbook step: cordon + drain affected nodes, spin replacement from hotpool. Starting now.
Sam: thanks. Priya — can we temporarily relax the reserved-only policy to allow burst from shared spare capacity to avoid customer requests queuing? Need approval from infra.
Priya: I'm approving a temporary policy override for this tenant for 20 minutes. Jordan, please apply.
Jordan: applied policy override: allow-burst=true for cluster=dedicated-acme-eu-west, ttl=20m. Command used:
```
infra-admin set-tenant-policy --tenant acmecorp --cluster dedicated-acme-eu-west --allow-burst true --ttl 20m
```
Jordan: also scaled reserved pool by +2 nodes from backup hotpool:
```
infra-admin scale-pool --pool dedicated-acme-eu-west-reserved --delta 2
```
Sam: queue length dropping: 620 -> 180 in 90s. 5xx rate falling to 2.4%. p95 now 450ms.
Maya: told AcmeCorp support we're routing additional capacity and investigating root cause; asked them to validate critical flows.
Priya: we should also enable fallback model route for critical customer requests to reduce per-request GPU memory. Sam, can you flip the route?
Sam: enabling fallback to model redwood-small-v1 for tenant-specific route (degraded-quality mode). Executing: 
```
console-cli route update --tenant acmecorp --route /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood-small-v1 --grace 30s
```
Sam: fallback enabled. Noting client experience may degrade but throughput improves.
Sam: p95 dropped to 320ms, p99 ~ 1.2s, 5xx rate 0.8%. Queue at 60.
Jordan: drained three faulty nodes and reprovisioned replacements; GPUs stable on replacements. I'll leave cordoned nodes for postmortem.
Priya: assigning action items: Jordan to collect GPU driver logs + node hardware metrics, Sam to capture request traces for affected tenant and timeframe, Maya to draft customer incident note and coordinate follow-ups.
Sam: oncall handoff note for next shift (in 30m): status=stabilized; mitigation=scale-up + policy-override + fallback-route; risk=rollback not required; next steps=postmortem and limit testing for reserved bursting logic.
Maya: sending interim customer update: "We have temporarily routed additional capacity and enabled a degraded-quality fallback for some requests. Our engineers are stabilizing the dedicated cluster and will follow up with a detailed incident report."
Priya: PD escalation cleared — PagerDuty shows the incident acknowledged and progress noted.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Sam at 1796201240, last status update 1796201800.
Sam: leaving a short debug snippet for postmortem collection:
```
# collect traces for timeframe
admin-tool fetch-traces --tenant acmecorp --since 1796199600 --until 1796201400 > acme-traces.json
# gpu driver logs
infra-admin fetch-logs --nodes node-a,node-b,node-c --component nvidia-driver > gpu-drivers.log
```
Jordan: uploading collected logs to /internal/incidents/acme-1796201234.
Maya: scheduled customer sync at 10:30 UTC with AcmeCorp PM.
Sam: moving to resolve — monitoring for 10m window before resolving PagerDuty. If we see re-escalation, reopen immediately. :eyes: 
Priya: noted. Will start postmortem doc template.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident 1796201234 status=acknowledged, severity=P1, service=dedicated-reserved-pool, assignees=[Sam], tags=[acmecorp,dedicated]
Sam: thanks team. Closing thread for now, will append postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
